descriptionByLocale.en:
Your job is to evaluate and care for children, adolescents 0-18 years of age and their families in an outpatient setting within CAP. CAP also works closely with UHPA (Unit d, hospitalisation Psychiatric pour Adolescents) and with the emergency room of the hospital of Moutier, which can respond to the request for urgent outpatient consultation.
• The tasks of the project are:
• The conduct of child-psychiatric assessments and care of patients on an independent basis
• The supervision and supervision of the assistant physician and the assistant psychologist in training
• The demonstration of the capacity to provide, support, manage complex cases in the field and take decisions and the responsibilities of a 2nd line senior physician
• The Medicin's role in the site, the CAP's reference medicin-cheffe, in terms of the tasks involved in the organisation of the site and the proper operation of the catches
• Develop and implement treatment plans in collaboration with the medico-therapeutic team.
• Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans if necessary
• Prescribe and manage psychiatric drugs
• Participate in the outpatient care continuity system.
• Intervene in case of crisis and provide emergency child psychiatric care, if necessary.
• Participate in meetings of the medical-therapeutic team to discuss patient care.
• Develop accurate and detailed electronic medical records.
• To participate in the development and implementation of child-psychiatric protocols and procedures in the outpatient and hospital sector
• To collaborate with other health-care providers to ensure comprehensive care for patients.
• To possess a medical degree or equivalent qualification recognized by the Federal Commission for Medical Professions (MEBE Ko) is compulsory.
• An experience of at least 3 years of assistance, including at least 2 years of psychiatry and psychotherapy for children and adolescents, in addition to a further year(s) in adult psychiatry or paediatrics is required
• A proven ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team is essential.
• A strong commitment to medical training and knowledge dissemination is required.
• Capacity for initiative, curiosity and interest in implementing projects.
• Mastering the French language at a minimum level of B2 is required. We offer a varied and stimulating activity within a dynamic and constantly evolving establishment. The teams benefit from a high quality professional guidance and from real career development prospects and very good remuneration conditions. Thanks to a highly qualified multidisciplinary team and a high-performance technical platform, we guarantee a working environment conducive to excellence. The main focus of the programme is on continuing training, which enables everyone to develop their skills and develop their skills in a professional way.
